https drdo go|advtdyslsm08092026.raw_text: DEFENCE RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT ORGANISATION (www.drdo.gov.in) Advertisement No. DYSL-SM/HRD/JRF/REC/2026/1 dated 04-09-2026 DRDO YOUNG SCIENTISTS’ LABORATORY FOR SMART MATERIALS (DYSL-SM) Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad – 500 058 URL: http://www.drdo.gov.in Walk-in-Interview for the award of Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) DRDO Young Scientists’ Laboratory for Smart Materials (DYSL-SM) is dedicated to the development of smart material technology solutions for national defence. The laboratory specialises in accelerated materials development, micro-robotics and stealth technologies. Indian Nationals are invited for walk-in-interview on 06.10.2026 @ 09:30 hrs for the position of One (01) Junior Research Fellow (JRF) to work on project in the area of Development of Smart Materials based robotic application including shape memory alloy and piezoelectric Materials. S. No. Subject Qualification Post / Nos. 01. Mechanical Engineering Essential Qualification: B.E/B.Tech. in Mechanical/Mechatronics Engineering with First Class with a valid GATE score (OR) M.E./M.Tech. with First class in MechanicalMechatronics / Robotics & Automation/Machine Design/Solid Mechanics and B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical/Mechatronics Engineering with First class. Desirable criteria: Working knowledge of finite element packages, CAD, 3D Printing, Composite Materials, basic electronics and instrumentation JRF / 01 No. General Conditions: 1. The eligible candidates can “WALK IN FOR INTERVIEW ” at DRDO Young Scientists Laboratory for Smart Materials (DYSL- SM), AMTL Campus (near DMRL), KANCHANBAGH, HYDERABAD-500058 on 06.10.2026 @ 09:30 hrs. Late comers will not be allowed. 2. While appearing for interview, the candidates are required to bring all original certificates and submit the prescribed application form with recent passport size photograph affixed on top right corner of the first page and one set of self -attested copies of all Degrees/Academic qualification certificates/Mark Sheets/Experience Certificates etc. Application Form can be downloaded from the DRDO website www.drdo.gov.in ( DRDO website > Vacancies). Duly filled in application form with supporting documents in PDF format shall be submitted online on email ID: hrd.dysl-sm@gov.in (below 10MB). 3. Screening of eligible applications will be based on GATE score, marks secured in degree, fulfilment of desirability criteria and relevant work experience (if any).
